title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E06 — Obsessions Gone Too Far
A teacher is accused of being a sex offender; a woman is obsessed with her next-door neighbors.

title: You Better Watch Out
description: A woman stumbles into the middle of a kidnapping while stranded at a small-town airport on Christmas Eve.

title: Do You Fear What I Fear?
description: Claire lands her dream job in the city, but her fresh start soon turns chilling when eerie holiday decorations begin appearing in her apartment, each one a message from someone who knows her all too well.

title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Murder
description: After inheriting an old house from her beloved aunt, Diana Hart finds clues that suggest her aunt was murdered and the culprit might be her handsome companion.

title: A Christmas Winter Song
description: Clio, a Christmas shop owner, forms a special musical bond with Fred, a former jazz singer. Having just lost her own father, Clio helps Fred reconnect with his own daughter and grandchildren, just in time for the town's annual Christmas concert.

title: Christmas Harmony
description: A singer-songwriter is used to living in the shadow of her pop star boyfriend, but he breaks up with her right before the holiday season. She returns to her hometown to discover the heart and music that her big city life has been missing.

title: All She Wants for Christmas
description: A woman (Monica Keena) uncovers secrets while evaluating a Christmas ornament company in her hometown.

title: Eve's Christmas
description: A lonely career woman (Elisa Donovan) gets a second chance to rethink a fateful decision after she makes a wish upon a Christmas Eve star.

title: Radio Christmas
description: When her Philadelphia radio station is closed for repairs during the holidays, DJ Kara Porter is forced to broadcast from the small town of Bethlehem.

title: A Twist of Christmas
description: In the frenzy before Christmas, two single parents accidentally mix up their toys at a crowded department store. Although the two can't stand each other, they decide to try to help each other salvage their holiday plans.

title: 3 Holiday Tails
description: Lisa's three puppies interrupt a wedding proposal, and she is shocked to see it is her ex-boyfriend David proposing to his new girlfriend. Everyone can see they are meant to be together, so the dogs decide to help them get back together.

description: A curmudgeonly kitty helps a little girl find the spirit and charm of Christmas, in a holiday adventure.

description: A country-music singer (Desiree Ross) reunites with her father (Brian McKnight), while appearing in a competition hosted by Dolly Parton.

description: A dog (Brenda Song) tries to thwart the romance between her owner (Cynthia Gibb) and a widowed architect (Greg Evigan).
